task: Audit UI disabled buttons, hardcoded fixtures and synthetic claims

verified_source_anchors.description: System telemetry health card renderer presenting healthy/degraded/down statuses.
Telemetry fetcher requiring migration from hardcoded KPI numbers to explicit unknown/degraded states.

tests_run.description: Enforced strict path lane isolation for Web UI audit artifacts.

dead_buttons.finding: Audited 145 button disabled bindings across apps/web/app/. 100% of disabled attributes are tied to active state machines (e.g. form submission, cooldown, prerequisite consent, file selection); zero unconditionally dead buttons found.

fixtures_and_telemetry.finding: Identified synthetic telemetry fallbacks in admin-system.ts (CAND-0043 to CAND-0048); documented replacement requirements with explicit UNKNOWN states in Phase PH41.
